name: @resolve/extension
description: Resolve browser extension (WXT, Manifest V3) for Chrome, Brave, Edge and Firefox.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs extension && node ../../scripts/extract-nsfw-model.mjs && wxt build && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.zip: node ../../scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs extension && node ../../scripts/extract-nsfw-model.mjs && wxt zip && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.build:dev: node ../../scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs extension && node ../../scripts/extract-nsfw-model.mjs && wxt build --mode development
